sections: Money is one of the few areas where progress can make the finish line move farther away. A salary that once sounded enormous becomes ordinary. A savings target becomes the starting point for a larger one. The numbers improve, but the feeling of finally being secure can remain strangely distant.

Part of the problem is that we often inherit financial goals before we define what they are for. Saving, investing and earning more can all be sensible goals, but without a personal definition of enough they can become an endless test we never pass.
